summary.text: John Healy, a Republican Queens native and, as of March 2025, President of the Sunnyside GOP Club, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Senate District 13 to Jessica González-Rojas.
He ran for New York City Council District 26 in 2025 on the Republican and Conservative lines and lost to incumbent Julie Won.

paragraphs.text: Healy is a Queens native who, as of the New York Young Republican Club's March 2025 endorsement, served as President of the Sunnyside GOP Club.

In 2025 he ran for New York City Council District 26 in western Queens on the Republican and Conservative Party lines, and lost the November 4, 2025 general election to incumbent Julie Won, receiving 18.3% (7,498 votes) to her 81.4% (33,425 votes).

He was on the November 3, 2026 ballot as the Republican candidate for the open State Senate District 13 seat; the June 23, 2026 Republican primary was canceled and he advanced without appearing on the ballot.
He received 20.5% of the vote to Jessica González-Rojas's 79.0%, according to unofficial results reported by Ballotpedia and Wikipedia.
